buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms & Conditions (Guidelines) 1. Deployment & Work Execution Gender Eligibility: Keeping in view the security and operational requirements of the Corps Camp p remises, only male cooks deployed by the L-1 firm are eligible for this work. Duty Timings: It is mandatory for all hired cooks to be present on duty inside the camp premises fr om 06:00 AM to 06:00 PM (0600 hrs to 1800 hrs) daily.

Scope of Work: Hired cooks must prepare high-quality breakfast, lunch, and dinner daily within the scheduled timings. Boarding & Lodging: The deployed cooks must make their own arrangements for boarding and lo dging outside the camp premises. No accommodation or stay facilities will be provided inside th e camp. Contract Rates: The work shall be strictly executed at the final competitive rates quoted by the su ccessful L-1 firm in the bid. 2. Statutory Compliance, Security & Verification Police Verification: It is mandatory for the L-1 firm to get the police verification done for all deploy ed cooks and submit the official reports to the battalion before commencing work. Leave & Substitution: No cook will be granted leave during the execution of this work. If a replac ement becomes absolutely necessary under emergency circumstances, the new personnel can only be deployed after undergoing a fresh police verification process. Medical Fitness: It is mandatory for all hired cooks to submit a comprehensive medical examinatio n fitness report before deployment. Identity Proofs: Post-bid/RA allocation, the L-1 firm must mandatorily provide the Aadhaar Cards and passport-size photographs of all the finalized cooks. � Mandatory Technical Bid Documents Firms must upload the following clear documents while participating in the bid. Failure to upload any of these documents will result in direct disqualification at the Technical Bid evaluation stage: 1. Copy of PAN Card 2. Copy of Aadhaar Card 3. Firm's GST Registration Certificate 4. MSME Certificate (if applicable) 5. Past Performance / Experience Certificate 6. Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the last 3 Financial Years 7. Dealership / Authorization Letter 8. Valid Labour Certificate .
